{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, check for the QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Drop QA orders
filtered_data = data[data['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Drop refunded orders
completed_orders = filtered_data[filtered_data['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
completed_orders['revenue_float'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")

# Return the value for submission
mean_revenue"}
